properties.rationale: Deferred on Anthony's word, 2026-07-28. Accepted and not dropped: reflow re-read the architecture anchor at phase transitions, at resync, and every 5 iterations, explicitly to "remind yourself of design intent and constraints"; reflow2's periodic re-injection carries loop DEBT instead, which says what you owe rather than what you were trying to build. Deferred and coupled to two open questions rather than blocked by them — the trigger depends on req:build-loop-is-bounded (parked the same day), and which node type carries the payload depends on dec:anchor-retire-or-implement (Snapshot at 14 instances versus Anchor at zero and still advertised). The recording vocabulary already exists, so when this is built it is the re-reading that is new, not the schema.
